# Cyklopper

> Atelier vélo participatif à Bruxelles / Participatief fietswerkplaats in Brussel

Cyklopper is a community bicycle repair workshop based in Brussels, Belgium.
It offers free and participatory repair sessions, tools, and skill-sharing for cyclists of all levels.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cyklopper.be/): Main page with overview, news, and contact
- [Présentation](https://cyklopper.be/01_presentation/): About the workshop and its mission
- [Équipe](https://cyklopper.be/02_team/): The people behind Cyklopper
- [Infos pratiques](https://cyklopper.be/03_info/): Opening hours, location, how to participate
- [Actualités](https://cyklopper.be/actu/): Latest news and events
- [Galerie](https://cyklopper.be/gallery/): Photos from workshops and events

## Events

- Cosmik Bike Festival 2025: Annual cycling culture festival organised by Cyklopper
  - Archive: [https://cyklopper.be/cosmik-2025/](https://cyklopper.be/cosmik-2025/)
